title: Black Lace Sleeves & Pale Blue Sky
prompt: An original young woman with blonde hair framing her face peeks out through black lace sleeves that rise above her head. She wears a black floral lace top with a soft tied neckline. Her expression is calm and direct, with soft peach lips. A pale blue sky and blurred foliage in the background. Soft natural light. Palette of black, peach, and sky blue. Romantic and dramatic, in the style of a summer lace editorial.
workingNotes:
- The lace sleeves framing the face are the central composition.
- Add 'shallow depth of field' to blur the background.
